caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: St. Lucia
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia in the Lesser Antilles is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 10 kt and seas building to 4.7 ft with E swell at 7s periods. 100% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Venice
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice in the Central Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 17 kt and seas building to 2.4 ft with ENE swell at 4s periods. 75% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.
